fieldValues.title: Silent environment effects mislead agents
fieldValues.statement: Quiet differences in the agent's environment change results without any error: a shallow clone makes history checks report real commits as absent, and an attribution variable set for memory writes breaks unrelated tests. The agent draws a confident wrong conclusion.
source_ref: srs-context:Shallow clones make git-history checks silently wrong
srs-context:SRS_ACTOR from the context hook makes srs-rust CLI tests fail
